### Borea v0.6.16

A patch release for the community macOS port of KSA. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### macOS

- Borea finds and starts the game from [ksa-macos-port](https://github.com/renancamm/ksa-macos-port), a community port that runs KSA natively on macOS without Wine. This is not an official macOS build of the game. Borea looks for the port's app in `/Applications` and `~/Applications`.
- StarMap starts through the port's app and uses the port's .NET runtime, so your Mac needs no .NET of its own.
- "Keep this game build" is not available for a game inside a macOS app, because a copy cannot start without the app.

Thanks to @renancamm for the port and for this change.

Full changelog: [v0.6.15...v0.6.16](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.15...v0.6.16)
